Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Plaid Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Flatweave, Grey, Ivory, Red
Colors: Gray, Ivory, Red
Materials: stone
Large plaid squares with red accents bring casual warmth to a modern or farmhouse decor. This handwoven rug will bring dimension to a hallway or entryway. PET fiber, created from recycled plastic, makes it easy to maintain. 2' 6" x 8' Low pile is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
